injury_reports.name: Tyson Bagent
injury_reports.summary: With Caleb Williams (hamstring) active, Tyson Bagent will serve as the Bears' backup quarterback against the Falcons on Sunday, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Luther Burden III
injury_reports.summary: Burden secured all eight targets for 95 yards in the Bears' 31-23 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jonah Jackson
injury_reports.summary: Jackson is dealing with a hip flexor, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Roschon Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson rushed 13 times for 51 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 31-23 win over the Falcons. He caught both of his targets for 34 yards.

injury_reports.name: Colston Loveland
injury_reports.summary: Loveland brought in six of seven targets for 65 yards and a touchdown in the Bears' 31-23 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Kyle Monangai
injury_reports.summary: Monangai (thumb/toe) was listed as a non-participant in Tuesday's walk-through.

injury_reports.name: Rome Odunze
injury_reports.summary: Odunze brought in three of four targets for 39 yards in the Bears' 31-23 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Kalif Raymond
injury_reports.summary: Raymond caught three of four passes for six yards and logged one carry for minus-2 yards during the Bears' 31-7 loss to the Packers on Sunday. He also returned one punt for nine yards.

injury_reports.name: D'Andre Swift
injury_reports.summary: Swift rushed 16 times for 44 yards and two touchdowns and brought in four of five targets for 26 yards in the Bears' 31-23 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jahdae Walker
injury_reports.summary: Walker went without a target while playing 10 of the Bears' 77 snaps on offense in Sunday's 31-23 win over the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Caleb Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams completed 30 of 36 passes for 305 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions while adding four rushes for three yards in the Bears' 31-23 win over the Falcons on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.

injury_reports.name: T.J. Edwards
injury_reports.summary: Edwards (hamstring) was estimated as a non-participant on the Bears' official injury report Monday.

injury_reports.name: Keyshaun Elliott
injury_reports.summary: Elliott (quadriceps) was estimated as a full participant on the Bears' official injury report Monday.

injury_reports.name: Kyler Gordon
injury_reports.summary: Gordon posted four solo tackles, including 3.0 sacks, and two forced fumbles during the Bears' 31-23 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Cam Lewis
injury_reports.summary: Lewis returned to Sunday's game against the Falcons, Brad Biggs of the Chicago Tribune reports.

injury_reports.name: Jack Sanborn
injury_reports.summary: Sanborn (concussion) was estimated as a non-participant on the Bears' official injury report Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Tyrique Stevenson Sr.
injury_reports.summary: Stevenson (hip) was estimated as a full participant on the Bears' official injury report Monday.

injury_reports.name: Montez Sweat
injury_reports.summary: The NFL announced Tuesday that Sweat has been suspended two games without pay for violating the league's performance-enhancing substances policy, Brad Biggs of the Chicago Tribune reports.

injury_reports.name: Shemar Turner
injury_reports.summary: The Bears activated Turner (knee) from their reserve/PUP list Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Cairo Santos
injury_reports.summary: Santos made one of his two field-goal attempts and all four PATs in the Bears' 31-23 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Dayo Odeyingbo
injury_reports.summary: The Bears placed Odeyingbo (quadriceps) on injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Anthony Johnson Jr.
injury_reports.summary: ir

injury_reports.name: A.J. Brown
injury_reports.summary: Brown (ankle) was listed as a limited participant on Tuesday's practice report.

injury_reports.name: Ben Brown
injury_reports.summary: Coach Mike Vrabel said Tuesday that Brown (knee) probably won't be available for Thursday's game against the Bears, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Will Campbell
injury_reports.summary: Campbell (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Jets.

injury_reports.name: DeMario Douglas
injury_reports.summary: Douglas caught seven of eight targets for 86 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-19 win over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: TreVeyon Henderson
injury_reports.summary: Henderson (ankle) rushed seven times for 31 yards and brought in his only target for nine yards in the Patriots' 26-19 win over the Jets on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

injury_reports.name: Hunter Henry

injury_reports.name: CJ Donaldson
injury_reports.summary: Donaldson logged six carries for 39 yards and lost a fumble during the Saints' 34-27 win over the Giants on Sunday. He also recorded three tackles (one solo) on special teams.

injury_reports.name: Juwan Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson failed to reel in either of his targets during Sunday's 34-27 win over the Giants.

injury_reports.name: Alvin Kamara
injury_reports.summary: Kamara carried the ball seven times for 34 yards and caught two of four targets for 35 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-27 win over the Giants.

injury_reports.name: Bryce Lance
injury_reports.summary: Lance caught two of four passes for nine yards and a touchdown during the Saints' 34-27 win over the Giants on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Kendre Miller
injury_reports.summary: Miller carried the ball 20 times for 70 yards and caught both his targets for zero yards in Sunday's 34-27 win over the Giants.

injury_reports.name: Chris Olave
injury_reports.summary: Olave caught four of seven targets for 43 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-27 win over the Giants.

injury_reports.name: Cesar Ruiz
injury_reports.summary: Ruiz (knee) made the trip to Paris ahead of the Saints' game against the Steelers in Week 7, Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football reports.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Shough
injury_reports.summary: Shough completed 16 of 30 passes for 144 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 34-27 win over the Giants. He added 32 yards and a TD on five carries.

injury_reports.name: Devaughn Vele
injury_reports.summary: Vele caught three of six targets for 42 yards during the Saints' 34-27 win over the Giants on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jeremiah Wright
injury_reports.summary: Wright (concussion) is active for Sunday's game against the Giants.

injury_reports.name: Vernon Broughton

injury_reports.name: Zachariah Branch
injury_reports.summary: Branch caught both of his targets for nine yards while adding 85 yards as a kick returner during Sunday's 31-23 loss to Chicago.

injury_reports.name: Andy Dalton
injury_reports.summary: Dalton agreed to a one-year contract with the Falcons on Monday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injury_reports.name: Jahan Dotson
injury_reports.summary: Dotson caught three of five targets for 87 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 31-23 loss to Chicago.

injury_reports.name: Drake London
injury_reports.summary: London brought in four of 10 targets for 62 yards in the Falcons' 31-23 loss to the Bears on Sunday. He also recorded a two-point conversion catch.

injury_reports.name: Jake Matthews
injury_reports.summary: Matthews (groin) is active for Sunday night's game against the Ravens, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Michael Penix Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Penix completed 19 of 33 passes for 225 yards and three touchdowns with no interceptions while rushing once for one yard in the Falcons' 31-23 loss to the Bears on Sunday. He also threw two two-point conversion passes.

injury_reports.name: Kyle Pitts Sr.
injury_reports.summary: Pitts brought in five of seven targets for 60 yards and two touchdowns in the Falcons' 31-23 loss to the Bears on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Bijan Robinson
injury_reports.summary: Robinson rushed nine times for 61 yards and brought in both targets for minus-8 yards in the Falcons' 31-23 loss to the Bears on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Robinson rushed once for one yard while reeling in both of his targets for nine yards during Sunday's 31-23 loss to the Bears.

injury_reports.name: Tua Tagovailoa
injury_reports.summary: With Michael Penix (ribs) cleared to play Sunday against the Bears, Tagovailoa will handle backup duties for the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Billy Bowman Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Bowman (hamstring) is doubtful to return to Sunday's game against Atlanta, William McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Kendal Daniels
injury_reports.summary: The Falcons announced after Sunday's 31-23 loss to the Bears that Daniels (neck) was alert and had movement in all his extremities after being carted off the field in the third quarter and transported to Grady Memorial Hospital.

injury_reports.name: Divine Deablo
injury_reports.summary: Deablo (arm) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Bears, William McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: C.J. Henderson
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Za'Darius Smith
injury_reports.summary: Smith (neck) is active for Sunday's game against the Bears.

injury_reports.name: Avieon Terrell
injury_reports.summary: Terrell (head) returned to Sunday's game against the Bears, William McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Nick Folk
injury_reports.summary: Folk made his sole PAT in the Falcons' 31-23 loss to the Bears on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Elic Ayomanor
injury_reports.summary: Ayomanor caught one of two passes for 17 yards during the Titans' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Sunday. He also added a tackle on special teams.

injury_reports.name: Gunnar Helm
injury_reports.summary: Helm was on the field for 33 of 46 offensive snaps (71.7 percent) but didn't show up on the box score otherwise during the Titans' 26-20 win over the Colts on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: David Martin-Robinson
injury_reports.summary: Martin-Robinson (hamstring) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Tony Pollard
injury_reports.summary: Pollard carried the ball 19 times for 76 yards and failed to catch his only target in Sunday's 26-20 win over the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Calvin Ridley
injury_reports.summary: Ridley failed to haul in either of his two targets during the Titans' 26-20 win over the Colts on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
injury_reports.summary: Robinson caught three of seven targets for 22 yards during Sunday's 26-20 win over the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Tyjae Spears
injury_reports.summary: Spears rushed once for one yard while reeling in his only target for seven yards during Sunday's 26-20 win over Indianapolis.

injury_reports.name: Carnell Tate
injury_reports.summary: Tate caught six of seven targets for 70 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-20 win over the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Cam Ward
injury_reports.summary: Ward completed 11 of 22 passes for 102 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Sunday's 26-20 win over the Colts. He added seven yards on three carries.

injury_reports.name: Tony Adams
injury_reports.summary: Adams (ankle) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Cor'Dale Flott
injury_reports.summary: Flott (chest) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice session.

injury_reports.name: Amani Hooker
injury_reports.summary: Hooker (concussion) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Joshua Williams
injury_reports.summary: The Titans activated Williams (pectoral) from reserve/PUP on Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Kevin Winston Jr.
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Joey Slye
injury_reports.summary: Slye went 4-for-4 on field-goal tries and made both of his PATs during Sunday's 26-20 win over the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Joseph Ossai

injury_reports.name: Tyler Allgeier
injury_reports.summary: Allgeier rushed 18 times for 38 yards and caught one of two targets for 10 yards in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Carson Beck
injury_reports.summary: Beck (coach's decision) is inactive and is designated as Arizona's emergency third quarterback for Sunday's matchup versus the Rams, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Kendrick Bourne
injury_reports.summary: Bourne caught five of eight targets for 47 yards during the Cardinals' 18-16 win over the Rams on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Shawn Bowman
injury_reports.summary: Bowman was signed from the practice squad to the active roster Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: Jacoby Brissett
injury_reports.summary: Brissett completed 24 of 35 passes for 218 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Rams. He also rushed twice for two yards.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Brooks
injury_reports.summary: Brooks caught two of three targets for 30 yards and returned a kickoff for 25 yards during Sunday's 18-16 win over the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Elijah Higgins
injury_reports.summary: Higgins caught all three of his targets for 28 yards during the Cardinals' 18-16 win over the Rams on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Bam Knight
injury_reports.summary: Knight rushed 15 times for 80 yards and caught both of his targets for 18 yards in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Jeremiyah Love
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that Love (ankle) is expected to do some running Tuesday, Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Trey McBride
injury_reports.summary: McBride caught seven of nine targets for 53 yards in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Teagan Quitoriano
injury_reports.summary: Quitoriano caught both of his targets for 15 yards and two touchdowns during Sunday's 45-21 loss to Detroit.

injury_reports.name: Reggie Virgil
injury_reports.summary: Virgil recorded two receptions for 29 yards on five targets in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Lions.

injury_reports.name: Michael Wilson
injury_reports.summary: Wilson caught four of seven targets for 32 yards in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Budda Baker
injury_reports.summary: Baker (groin) is active for Sunday's game against the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Zaven Collins
injury_reports.summary: Collins (hip) is active for Sunday's game against the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Kitan Crawford
injury_reports.summary: Crawford (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Wydett Williams Jr.
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Andrew Wingard
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Chad Ryland
injury_reports.summary: Ryland converted all six of his field-goal attempts during Arizona's win over the Rams on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: James Conner
injury_reports.summary: Conner (foot) is close to practicing, but the Cardinals aren't expected to open his 21-day evaluation window this week, John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM reports.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Badie
injury_reports.summary: Badie (thumb) won't return to Thursday's game against Seattle, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports. He finished with one carry for six yards.

injury_reports.name: J.K. Dobbins
injury_reports.summary: Dobbins rushed 17 times for 41 yards and a touchdown and brought in all three targets for five yards during the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Evan Engram
injury_reports.summary: Engram caught both targets for 13 yards in Denver's 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday night.

injury_reports.name: RJ Harvey
injury_reports.summary: Harvey rushed six times for 25 yards and a touchdown and brought in three of four targets for 31 yards in the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Lil'Jordan Humphrey
injury_reports.summary: The Broncos signed Humphrey off the practice squad to the active roster Friday.

injury_reports.name: Marvin Mims Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Mims caught two of four passes for 13 yards, returned one punt for 11 yards and returned one kickoff for 24 yards during the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Bo Nix
injury_reports.summary: Nix completed 17 of 27 passes for 107 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and rushed four times for two yards in the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday. He also recovered a fumble.

injury_reports.name: Courtland Sutton
injury_reports.summary: Sutton brought in two of three targets for 19 yards in the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Jaylen Waddle
injury_reports.summary: Waddle secured four of seven targets for 24 yards in the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Kris Abrams-Draine
injury_reports.summary: Abrams-Draine recorded six tackles (four solo), three pass breakups, including an interception, and one forced fumble in Thursday night's 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Jonathon Cooper
injury_reports.summary: Cooper (personal) was reinstated from the Commissioner Exempt List on Friday, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

injury_reports.name: Talanoa Hufanga
injury_reports.summary: doubtful

injury_reports.name: Brandon Jones
injury_reports.summary: Jones recorded eight tackles (three solo) in Thursday night's 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Ja'Quan McMillian
injury_reports.summary: McMillian recorded five tackles (five solo), including 1.0 sacks, and a pair of pass breakups, including an interception, in Thursday night's 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Riley Moss
injury_reports.summary: Moss (ribs) is available for Thursday's game against the Seahawks, Aric DiLalla of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Alex Singleton
injury_reports.summary: Singleton recorded 13 tackles (four solo) in Thursday night's 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Pat Surtain II
injury_reports.summary: doubtful

injury_reports.name: Wil Lutz
injury_reports.summary: Lutz made his lone field goal and both of his extra-point tries during the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Pat Bryant
injury_reports.summary: Bryant (ankle) was placed on the Broncos' injured reserve Friday.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Nailor
injury_reports.summary: Nailor caught one of four targets for nine yards during Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Bills.

injury_reports.name: Aidan O'Connell
injury_reports.summary: O'Connell (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Raiders' emergency third quarterback against the Bills on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Tre Tucker

injury_reports.name: Matt Gay
injury_reports.summary: Gay converted all three of his field-goal attempts and all three extra-point tries during Las Vegas' loss to the Bills on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Carter Runyon
injury_reports.summary: Runyon (lower body) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Bills, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.

injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Elijah Arroyo
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald confirmed with reporters Monday that Arroyo will miss "significant time" due to a shoulder injury that he picked up during Thursday's 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: AJ Barner
injury_reports.summary: Barner caught three of four passes for 16 yards during the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Sam Darnold
injury_reports.summary: Darnold completed 27 of 51 passes for 278 yards with no touchdowns and two interceptions and rushed twice for 19 yards in the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday. He also threw a two-point conversion pass.

injury_reports.name: George Holani
injury_reports.summary: Holani rushed five times for 20 yards and a touchdown in the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Tory Horton
injury_reports.summary: Horton caught one of five targets for 13 yards and returned a punt for 13 yards during the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday. He also logged one tackle.

injury_reports.name: Velus Jones Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Jones turned four carries into 20 yards and caught his only target for minus-1 yard during Thursday's 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Cooper Kupp
injury_reports.summary: Kupp caught five of 10 targets for 50 yards during the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Jadarian Price
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Price "should be looking at a sooner rather than later return after" the Seahawks' next game in Week 7, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Rashid Shaheed
injury_reports.summary: Shaheed brought in five of eight targets for 66 yards, rushed once for two yards, returned three kickoffs for 77 yards and ran back three punts for 39 yards in the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday. He also caught a two-point conversion pass and committed two fumbles, recovering one.

injury_reports.name: Jaxon Smith-Njigba
injury_reports.summary: Smith-Njigba brought in 12 of 16 targets for 134 yards in the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Emanuel Wilson
injury_reports.summary: Wilson rushed 14 times for 52 yards and failed to bring in his only target in the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Nick Emmanwori
injury_reports.summary: Emmanwori recorded seven tackles (four solo), including 1.0 sacks, in Thursday night's 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Ernest Jones IV
injury_reports.summary: Jones recorded nine tackles (five solo), including 1.0 sacks, in Thursday night's 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Tyrice Knight
injury_reports.summary: Knight will start in Thursday's game against the Broncos, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Chazz Surratt
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Drake Thomas
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Jason Myers
injury_reports.summary: Myers went 2-for-3 on field-goal attempts during the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Anthony Bradford
injury_reports.summary: Bradford (knee) was designated to return from injured reserve by the Seahawks on Monday, John Boyle of the team's official website reports.

injury_reports.name: Zach Charbonnet
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Charbonnet (knee) is slated for a "full week of work" and has a "good chance" to play Sunday night against the Chiefs, Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.

injury_reports.summary: Allen caught both of his passes for 27 yards during the Chiefs' 22-6 win over the Chargers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Andrew Armstrong
injury_reports.summary: Armstrong reverted to the Chiefs' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.

injury_reports.name: Noah Gray
injury_reports.summary: Gray caught all three of his targets for 53 yards during the Chiefs' 22-6 win over the Chargers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Emmett Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson turned three carries into six yards and caught two of three targets for 18 yards during Sunday's 22-6 win over the Chargers. He also returned two kickoffs for 50 yards.

injury_reports.name: Travis Kelce
injury_reports.summary: Kelce caught four of five targets for 53 yards during Sunday's 22-6 win over the Chargers.

injury_reports.name: Patrick Mahomes
injury_reports.summary: Mahomes completed 23 of 30 passes for 272 yards, no touchdowns and one interception and rushed five times for 16 yards during Sunday's 22-6 win versus the Chargers.

injury_reports.name: Jaylon Moore
injury_reports.summary: Moore (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Chargers.

injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Kenneth Walker III
injury_reports.summary: Walker ripped off 128 yards and two touchdowns on 19 carries and added two catches (on three targets) for 11 yards during Sunday's 22-6 win against the Chargers.

injury_reports.name: Xavier Worthy
injury_reports.summary: Worthy totaled seven catches on as many targets for 73 yards during Sunday's 22-6 victory versus the Chargers.

injury_reports.name: Nick Bolton
injury_reports.summary: Bolton posted nine tackles (four solo) during the Chiefs' 30-27 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Chamarri Conner
injury_reports.summary: Conner (knee) was a full participant at practice Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: Mansoor Delane
injury_reports.summary: Delane tallied 10 tackles (seven solo) and one pass defense during the Chiefs' 30-27 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: L'Jarius Sneed
injury_reports.summary: Sneed (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Matt McMullen of the Chiefs' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Harrison Butker
injury_reports.summary: Butker made three of his four field-goal attempts and one of two PATs in the Chiefs' 22-6 win over the Chargers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Cooper McDonald
injury_reports.summary: The Chiefs designated McDonald (knee) to return from injured reserve Tuesday, Charles Goldman of AtoZSports.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Tyquan Thornton
injury_reports.summary: The Chiefs placed Thornton (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Saquon Barkley
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Hollywood Brown
injury_reports.summary: NFL reporter Jordan Schultz reports that teams seeking help at wide receiver will likely call the Eagles about the status of Brown before the Nov. 10 deadline.

injury_reports.name: Darius Cooper
injury_reports.summary: Cooper caught one of two targets for nine yards and added 38 yards as a kick returner during Sunday's 25-14 loss to the Panthers.

injury_reports.name: Zach Ertz
injury_reports.summary: Ertz is not being elevated from the practice squad for Sunday's matchup against Carolina, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Dallas Goedert
injury_reports.summary: Goedert caught six of eight targets for 61 yards during Sunday's 25-14 loss to the Panthers.

injury_reports.name: Lane Johnson
injury_reports.summary: out

injury_reports.name: Drew Kendall
injury_reports.summary: Kendall (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

injury_reports.name: Makai Lemon
injury_reports.summary: Lemon caught three of six targets for 19 yards in Sunday's 25-14 loss to the Panthers.

injury_reports.name: Tanner McKee
injury_reports.summary: McKee completed 26 of 45 passes for 215 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions while adding one carry for no gain in the Eagles' 25-14 loss to the Panthers on Sunday. He also recovered a fumble.

injury_reports.name: Cole Payton
injury_reports.summary: Payton is active as the backup to starting quarterback Tanner McKee in Sunday's game against the Panthers.

injury_reports.name: Dameon Pierce
injury_reports.summary: Pierce rushed 12 times for 35 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for 15 yards in the Eagles' 25-14 loss to the Panthers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: DeVonta Smith
injury_reports.summary: Smith brought in seven of 14 targets for 75 yards and a touchdown in the Eagles' 25-14 loss to the Panthers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Dontayvion Wicks
injury_reports.summary: Wicks caught two of four passes for 24 yards during the Eagles' 25-14 loss to the Panthers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Michael Carter II
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: AJ Epenesa
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Jonathan Greenard
injury_reports.summary: Greenard (ankle) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against Carolina.

injury_reports.name: Jalyx Hunt
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Nolan Smith Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Smith (concussion) won't return to Sunday's game against Carolina.

injury_reports.name: Jake Elliott
injury_reports.summary: Elliott made both of his extra-point attempts during the Eagles' 25-14 loss to the Panthers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jakorian Bennett
injury_reports.summary: Bennett (knee) won't come off injured reserve this weekend and has been ruled out for Sunday's Week 6 battle against Carolina.

injury_reports.name: Grant Calcaterra
injury_reports.summary: The Eagles downgraded Calcaterra (back) to out Saturday for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

injury_reports.name: Landon Dickerson
injury_reports.summary: Dickerson (knee) has been downgraded to out for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Hurts
injury_reports.summary: Hurts (calf) is expected to be held out of football activities for multiple months and miss the rest of the season after new imaging over the weekend revealed several blood clots in his lungs, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

injury_reports.name: Eli Stowers
injury_reports.summary: The Eagles have downgraded Stowers (quadriceps) to out for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
